title: REQ · Lockfile root dependencies entry declares phaser ~3.90.0
description: Context: package-lock.json L15 reads "phaser": "^4.2.1", which disagrees with package.json L18 (~3.90.0). Desired behavior: the root entry equals the package.json specifier. Expected result: npm ci does not report lock/package mismatch. Why: a mismatched lock can install Phaser 4.
acceptance_criteria: Given package-lock.json, when the root dependencies.phaser is read, then it equals ~3.90.0
Given package.json and the lockfile root, when phaser specifiers are compared, then they are identical
